system.description: Healer Base List 8.5 - Organ Ways. Self-healing spells for nose, nerves, ears, eyes, paralysis, brain and organ damage, and reattaching a severed limb (Joining, shared with Blood/Bone/Muscle Ways).
Caster can repair any nose damage short of complete nose loss.
Caster can repair any minor nerve damage in 1 area. Recovery time is 5-50 minutes.
Caster can repair any external ear damage, including ear loss (regeneration takes 5-50 minutes).
Caster can repair any minor eye damage (e.g., corneal scratch, removal of foreign object, etc.).
As Minor Nerve Repair, except caster can repair any 1 area of major nerve damage. This will not repair destroyed nerves.
As Minor Ear Repair, except caster can also repair any internal ear damage (e.g., restore hearing). Recovery time is 1-10 hours.

Allows caster to reattach a severed limb. Also requires the use of Bone Ways, Muscle Ways, and Blood Ways Joining spells to restore limb to functional status. Limb will be fully functional in 1-10 days.
As Minor Eye Repair, except caster can repair any eye damage short of complete eye loss. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.
As Minor Nerve Repair, except that recovery is instantaneous.
Caster can repair any damage to 1 organ (except the brain) that has not been completely destroyed. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.
Caster can cure any paralysis problem. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.
Caster can regenerate all the nerves in his body (outside brain area). Recovery time is 1-10 hours.
As Major Nerve Repair, except that recovery is instantaneous.
As Joining, except caster must cast the other 3 Healer Joining True spells and recovery is instantaneous.
As Paralysis Cures, except recovery time is 5-50 minutes.
As Mass Nerve Regeneration, except recovery time is 5-50 minutes.

Caster can repair brain damage (such as that caused by a skull fracture, etc. at the discretion of the GM). Experience lost by brain damage to the wounded being (the one from whom the damage is transferred) is not restored. Should the Healer have brain damage inflicted directly upon him (e.g., he is struck in the head), he may suffer memory and/or experience loss. Recovery time is 1-10 hours.
Caster can regenerate any 1 organ (external or internal), but not the brain. The recovery time is 1-10 hours.
As Paralysis Cures, except recovery is instantaneous.

Caster may reunite his soul with his body, provided the body is functional. To restore a dead target to life, a Healer would first have to heal all of the target's wounds (without 'killing' himself), and then restore the target's soul by giving up his own. While technically alive, but without his soul, the Healer would be affected as if he had been 'absolved,' unable to take conscious actions and at -75 for all subconscious actions, until he regains his own soul through the use of this spell or through someone else casting the appropriate spell.
